event: AB 66 enacted — § 832.18 added — California's first statewide body-worn camera data management standards
source: California Legislative Information — AB 66 (2015) bill history
context_event_1: Michael Brown killing — Ferguson, Missouri — August 9, 2014 — no officer body camera; disputed factual account unresolved
context_event_2: Eric Garner killing — Staten Island, New York — July 17, 2014 — bystander footage undisputed; systemic BWC policies lacking
subsequent_legislation: AB 748 (Stats. 2019) — mandatory BWC footage disclosure for critical incidents; supplements § 832.18 framework
